setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays the four-step phrase (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) through a device with MIDI CCs, at 90 BPM with Rate /1, so one step lasts a sixth of a second. PARAMS is open on the device's CC 1 control at its stored value, 63, set in PARAMS > MOSAIC. CC 1 is not assigned to a Trig params slot yet, and parameter slides are off. This independent example enables the slide on step 1 only. Compare the whole-parameter glide separately at Param Slides; neither example requires the other’s project.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K1 to leave PARAMS. Turn E1 to Channel tasks, choose Trig params with E2 and press K3, then press K2 and turn E3 to CC 1 in the parameter list.
steps.title: Find CC 1

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign CC 1 and K2 to return. Slot 1 now reads 63, the stored value, with no marker in its corner, because no step has a lock for it yet.
steps.title: Assign CC 1 to the slot

steps.caption: Hold step 1 at (1,4) and turn E3 to 24. Slot 1 shows 24 with an L in its corner while the step is held. Release the step.
steps.title: Lock step 1 to 24

steps.caption: Hold step 3 at (3,4) and turn E3 to 96. Slot 1 shows 96 with the L. Release the step.
steps.title: Lock step 3 to 96

steps.caption: Hold step 4 at (4,4) and turn E3 to 48. Slot 1 shows 48 with the L. Release the step.
steps.title: Lock step 4 to 48

steps.caption: Hold step 1 at (1,4) and press K3. Slot 1 shows 24 with an S in its corner while step 1 is held, so only the slide that starts at step 1 is on. Release the step.
steps.title: Slide from step 1 only

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two loops play, then tap it again to stop. In the MIDI strip, CC 1 glides from 24 to 96 in equal steps of 12 (36, 48, 60, 72, 84) between steps 1 and 3, then jumps straight to 48 at step 4 with no glide.
steps.title: Play and watch the glide stop at step 3

steps.caption: Press K1 to open PARAMS. CC 1 still shows 63, the value you stored: the slide only shapes the messages sent while playing.
steps.title: The device setting does not change
